scope: Inspectable reference targets for a declared test environment. Procurement profiles may set stricter targets but must not silently weaken mandatory gates.

kpis.name: Local authorization latency P95
kpis.measurement: P95 policy-decision latency at the declared steady-state load, excluding client network time.

kpis.name: Local authorization latency P99
kpis.measurement: P99 policy-decision latency at the declared steady-state load, excluding client network time.

kpis.name: Material revocation convergence P95
kpis.measurement: P95 time from accepted revocation event to denial at every in-scope enforcement point.

kpis.name: Default privileged grant lifetime
kpis.measurement: Maximum default lifetime for a just-in-time privileged grant before explicit renewal.

kpis.name: Material-action evidence completeness
kpis.measurement: Share of material actions containing principal, purpose, policy revision, decision, approval, time, outcome and integrity digest.

kpis.name: Evidence tamper detection
kpis.measurement: Share of seeded alteration and deletion attempts detected by independent verification.

kpis.name: Unauthorized material actions accepted
kpis.measurement: Accepted actions across the mandatory negative authorization suite.

kpis.name: Unapproved direct camera egress
kpis.measurement: Successful unapproved Internet flows during the camera-zone isolation test.

kpis.name: Cross-tenant access successes
kpis.measurement: Successful reads, writes or authority reuse across tenant boundaries in the isolation suite.

kpis.name: External-isolation continuity
kpis.measurement: Continuous local authentication, authorization, revocation and evidence operation with external management routes removed.

kpis.name: Clean-room recovery time objective
kpis.measurement: Elapsed time to restore identity, policy, revocation and evidence verification in a clean environment.

kpis.name: Evidence recovery point objective
kpis.measurement: Maximum verified evidence gap after the reference recovery exercise.

kpis.name: Control-plane failover
kpis.measurement: Time to restore policy decisions after loss of one declared control-plane node.

kpis.name: Declared protocol conformance
kpis.measurement: Pass rate across the versioned protocol and portability suite, with every failed case disclosed.

kpis.name: Export and replacement restore success
kpis.measurement: Required identities, policies and evidence restored and functionally verified on a clean replacement implementation.

kpis.name: Vendor-independent runbook completion
kpis.measurement: Declared operating tasks completed by the authorized local team without supplier intervention.
